pending_screen.name: Ferrund
pending_screen.story: Coined from Latin ferrum (iron) and fundere (to pour or cast), which is the root of both 'foundry' and 'to found' a company. So it means an iron foundry that also founds things. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and the web shows only a rare French surname.
pending_screen.story_sr: Skovano od latinskog ferrum (gvožđe) i fundere (liti), korena reči 'livnica' i engleskog 'found' (osnovati): livnica gvožđa koja i osniva. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.name: Valifex
pending_screen.story: Latin valor (worth) plus -fex (maker), the ending of artifex (master craftsman), opifex and pontifex. It means 'the maker of value', which suits a company that builds and owns what it sells. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and it turns up only as online usernames.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko valor (vrednost) i -fex (tvorac), nastavak iz reči artifex (majstor), opifex i pontifex: 'tvorac vrednosti' za firmu koja pravi i poseduje ono što prodaje. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.name: Argund
pending_screen.story: Latin argentum (silver) plus fund- from fundere (to cast): 'the silver-caster'. It is hard, has two syllables and reads like an old Nordic first name. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and it exists only as a rare surname.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko argentum (srebro) i fund- od fundere (liti): 'livac srebra'. Zvuči kao staro nordijsko ime, a svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.name: Fabrund
pending_screen.story: Latin faber (smith, maker; the root of fabric and fabricate) plus fund- from fundere (to cast or found): 'the maker's foundry'. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and no business uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko faber (kovač, majstor; koren reči fabrika) i fund- od fundere (liti, osnovati): 'majstorova livnica'. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.name: Anfelt
pending_screen.story: Old Saxon anfelt and Old English anfilt both mean 'anvil', literally 'the thing struck upon'. It reads like a Scandinavian surname and hides a forge story inside a quiet holding name. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
pending_screen.story_sr: Staro-saksonsko anfelt i staroenglesko anfilt znače 'nakovanj', doslovno 'ono po čemu se udara'. Zvuči kao skandinavsko prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Domifex
pending_screen.story: Latin domi (at home) plus -fex (maker): 'the one who makes at home', which fits a company whose revenue comes mostly from its own products. Biologists already use it for a wolf spider that builds its own burrow 'castle' (Geolycosa domifex). No company uses it; .com is taken.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko domi (kod kuće) i -fex (tvorac): 'onaj koji pravi kod kuće', za firmu koja živi od sopstvenih proizvoda. Isto ime nosi vuk-pauk koji sam gradi svoju 'kulu' (Geolycosa domifex).

pending_screen.name: Dextan
pending_screen.story: Latin dexter (the skilled right hand; the root of dexterity) plus -an, so it reads like a real given name. The idea is skill of hand. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free and no company uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko dexter (vešta desna ruka, koren reči 'spretnost') i nastavak -an, pa zvuči kao pravo ime. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno, bez firmi pod tim imenom.

pending_screen.name: Amussen
pending_screen.story: Latin amussis was the Roman builder's straightedge, and 'ad amussim' means 'exactly, true to the rule', the same 'ad' idiom as Adacta. The Nordic -sen ending makes it sound like a surname (a rare Danish one). .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko amussis je rimski graditeljski lenjir, a 'ad amussim' znači 'tačno, po meri', isti 'ad' izraz kao Adacta. Sa nastavkom -sen zvuči kao prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Stannor
pending_screen.story: Latin stannum (tin), the metal that turns copper into bronze and is the basis of solder. That gives it Braze's joining-metals story without sounding like Braze. .com is taken; a ceiling-fan model uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko stannum (kalaj), metal koji od bakra pravi bronzu i osnova je lema: ista priča o spajanju metala kao Braze, a ne liči na nju. .com je zauzet; ime nosi i jedan model plafonskog ventilatora.

pending_screen.name: Obriza
pending_screen.story: Latin aurum obrizum was gold refined and proven in fire, the standard of true value; obriza is the Latin adjective form. It has the Br- and -za sounds the founder likes. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko aurum obrizum je zlato prečišćeno i provereno u vatri, merilo prave vrednosti; obriza je latinski pridevski oblik. Ima Br- i -za zvuk; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Excuda
pending_screen.story: From Latin excudere (to hammer out, to forge), as in Virgil's Aeneid 6.847: 'excudent alii spirantia mollius aera' ('others will forge breathing bronze more gently'). .com is taken. It is one letter away from the Spanish word excusa ('excuse').
pending_screen.story_sr: Od latinskog excudere (iskovati), kao kod Vergilija: 'excudent alii spirantia mollius aera' ('drugi će nežnije iskovati bronzu koja diše'). .com je zauzet; jedno slovo od španskog excusa ('izgovor').

pending_screen.name: Ambakt
pending_screen.story: Gaulish ambaktos ('one who serves') became Latin ambactus, Dutch ambacht ('craft, trade') and English ambassador, so one root covers both craft and client service. It has the hard -kt- ending. .com is taken; a UK AV-furniture brand uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Galsko ambaktos ('onaj koji služi') dalo je latinsko ambactus, holandsko ambacht ('zanat') i englesko ambassador: zanat i služenje klijentu u jednom korenu. .com je zauzet; ime koristi britanski brend nameštaja.

pending_screen.name: Forgan
pending_screen.story: English forge plus -an, built like Morgan, so it sounds like a person's name. It is also a rare Scottish place name and surname. .com is taken; Forgan of St Andrews has made golf clubs since 1860.
pending_screen.story_sr: Englesko forge (kovati, kovačnica) i nastavak -an po uzoru na Morgan, pa zvuči kao ime. .com je zauzet; postoji škotski proizvođač palica za golf Forgan (od 1860).

pending_screen.name: Malleon
pending_screen.story: Latin malleus (hammer), the root of 'malleable': the hammer that shapes metal, with the weight of an old name. .com and .io are taken. The name also belongs to a Game of Thrones maester and a small GitHub tool.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko malleus (čekić), koren reči 'malleable' (kovan, savitljiv): čekić koji oblikuje metal. .com i .io su zauzeti; ime se javlja u Igri prestola i kao mali GitHub alat.

pending_screen.name: Fervan
pending_screen.story: Latin fervere (to glow, to boil) describes the white heat of metal in the forge and is the root of fervent and ferment. The -an ending makes it read like a name. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free, and a school in Bogota uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko fervere (usijati se, ključati), usijanje metala u vatri i koren reči 'fervor'. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Ergan
pending_screen.story: Greek ergon (work, deed; the root of energy, ergonomics and organ) plus -an: a short two-syllable name for 'the work itself'. .com is taken and the other 6 domains are free. It exists only as a surname, but it is close to the already-used 'ergana'.
pending_screen.story_sr: Grčko ergon (delo, rad; koren reči energija i ergonomija) i nastavak -an: kratko ime za 'samo delo'. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Kaminor
pending_screen.story: Latin caminus (the smith's forge-hearth), which also gave Serbian kamin (fireplace), plus -or. It tells a Latin story and a local one at once. .com is taken; a Hungarian chimney firm and a pull-up-bar brand use the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko caminus (kovačko ognjište), od koga je i naša reč kamin, i nastavak -or: latinska i domaća priča u jednoj reči. .com je zauzet; koriste ga mađarska firma za dimnjake i brend šipki za zgibove.

pending_screen.name: Limator
pending_screen.story: Latin limare (to file, to polish) comes from Horace's 'limae labor et mora', the toil and patience of the file, meaning the careful finishing of a work. .com is taken; Lindner uses the name for a shredder model.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko limare (turpijati, glačati), iz Horacijevog 'limae labor et mora' (trud i strpljenje turpije), što znači brižljivo doterivanje dela. .com je zauzet; Lindner ima mašinu tog imena.

pending_screen.name: Querca
pending_screen.story: Latin quercus (oak) was the timber of shipwrights and roof beams and stands for strength that lasts. The name is short and hard. .com and .ai are taken; a UK medical-writing firm is called Querca Too.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko quercus (hrast), drvo brodograditelja i krovnih greda, simbol trajne snage. .com i .ai su zauzeti; postoji britanska firma Querca Too.

pending_screen.name: Fraxen
pending_screen.story: Latin fraxinus (ash) was the wood of tool handles and spear shafts. The Nordic -sen ending makes it read like a surname and gives a hard Fr-/-x- sound. .com is taken; Fraxen is also the name of a Romanian fractional-executive consultancy.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko fraxinus (jasen), drvo za drške alata i koplja, sa nordijskim nastavkom -sen, pa zvuči kao prezime. .com je zauzet; postoji rumunska konsultantska firma Fraxen.

pending_screen.name: Afabra
pending_screen.story: From Latin affabre ('skilfully, in a workmanlike way', from ad + faber), the same 'ad-' construction as Adacta (ad acta). .com is taken and the other 6 domains are free; a small firm in Lyon uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Od latinskog affabre ('majstorski, vešto', ad + faber), ista 'ad-' konstrukcija kao Adacta. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Orikal
pending_screen.story: From Greek oreikhalkos (orichalcum, 'mountain copper'), the gleaming legendary metal of Atlantis in Plato. .com and .ai are taken; a minor Marvel character is named Orikal.
pending_screen.story_sr: Od grčkog oreikhalkos (orihalkum, 'planinski bakar'), legendarni sjajni metal Atlantide kod Platona. .com i .ai su zauzeti; postoji i sporedni Marvelov lik tog imena.

pending_screen.name: Kilnor
pending_screen.story: English kiln (from Latin culina) plus -or: the kiln fires clay into brick and porcelain that last. .com, .app, .dev and .ai are taken, and the name belongs to a boss in the game Absolver.
pending_screen.story_sr: Englesko kiln (peć za pečenje, od latinskog culina) i nastavak -or: peć koja glinu pretvara u trajnu opeku i porcelan. .com, .app, .dev i .ai su zauzeti.

pending_screen.name: Fornel
pending_screen.story: Latin fornax (furnace) plus the diminutive -el: 'little furnace', a smith's small, precise fire. .com, .io and .app are taken. FORNEL is a registered US trademark for a wooden high chair, which is a different class.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko fornax (peć) i umanjenica -el: 'mala peć', malo i precizno kovačko ognjište. .com, .io i .app su zauzeti; FORNEL je registrovana marka u SAD za dečju stolicu.

pending_screen.name: Condra
pending_screen.story: From Latin condere (to found, to build): conditor means 'founder' and 'ab urbe condita' means 'from the founding of the city'. Only .studio is free; Condra Cranes in South Africa uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Od latinskog condere (osnovati, sagraditi): conditor je 'osnivač', a 'ab urbe condita' znači 'od osnivanja grada'. Slobodan je samo .studio; postoji Condra Cranes u Južnoj Africi.

pending_screen.name: Tornel
pending_screen.story: Latin tornus (the lathe or turner's wheel; the root of 'turn'), as in Horace's advice to send badly turned verses back to the anvil. .com is taken; Hulera Tornel is a well-known Mexican tire maker.
pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko tornus (strug; koren reči 'okretati'), kao kod Horacija, koji loše istrugane stihove vraća na nakovanj. .com je zauzet; Tornel je poznat meksički proizvođač guma.

pending_screen.name: Celaris
pending_screen.story: From the Latin maxim 'ars est celare artem' ('true art conceals its art'). That suits a quiet holding whose craft shows in its products, though it sounds softer than the founder's anchors. Only .studio and .dev are free; Celaris Energy and a UK healthcare consultancy use the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Iz latinske izreke 'ars est celare artem' (prava umetnost skriva svoju veštinu), što odgovara tihoj holding firmi čiji se zanat vidi u proizvodima. Slobodni su samo .studio i .dev.

pending_screen.name: Arkiton
pending_screen.story: From Greek arkhitekton (master builder: arkhi- 'chief' + tekton 'builder'). The -ton ending makes it read like a surname. .com, .io and .co are taken; architecture studios in Prishtina and the UAE use the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Od grčkog arhitekton (glavni graditelj: arhi- 'glavni' + tekton 'graditelj'), a nastavak -ton ga čini sličnim prezimenu. .com, .io i .co su zauzeti; ime koriste arhitektonski biroi u Prištini i UAE.
